## Notes

Bodies of up to 50 parts (WORK, MOVE, CARRY, ATTACK, RANGED_ATTACK, HEAL, CLAIM, TOUGH); lifespan 1,500 ticks; spawn budget 300 energy plus extensions; non-MOVE parts add fatigue 1/2/10 on road/plain/swamp and each MOVE part removes 2 per tick; 100 hits per part.
